description: Defines the FramePartsCollector class, a test utility for collecting and managing HTTP/2 frame parts during decoding, used in testing Http2FrameDecoderListener implementations.

classes.name: FramePartsCollector
classes.description: A test utility class that collects frame parts during HTTP/2 frame decoding for testing purposes.

methods.name: IsInProgress
methods.description: Checks if frame collection is currently in progress.

methods.name: current_frame
methods.description: Returns the current FrameParts being recorded.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of fully collected frames.

methods.name: frame
methods.description: Retrieves a specific collected frame by index.

methods.name: ExpectFrameHeader
methods.description: Sets an expected frame header for validation.

methods.name: StartFrame
methods.description: Begins recording a new frame, creating a FrameParts instance.

methods.name: StartAndEndFrame
methods.description: Handles frames that are fully processed in a single callback.

methods.name: CurrentFrame
methods.description: Returns the current frame being recorded.

methods.name: EndFrame
methods.description: Finalizes the current frame and stores it.

methods.name: FrameError
methods.description: Handles frame errors, such as size errors or padding issues.

methods.name: TestExpectedHeader
methods.description: Verifies that the header matches the expected header.
